name: DAO Swap trade rewards farmed with flash-loan round trips
summary: The DAO Swap router called its reward contract after every swap through the DAO/USDT pair, and the contract paid any trader that had staked 5,000 DAO about 0.7% of the swapped DAO amount from its reward pool, with no limit on volume or same-transaction round trips. The attacker staked 5,000 DAO, bought and sold DAO through the router about 30 times per transaction with 2.2M flash-loaned USDT, and sold the rewards into the PancakeSwap DAO/USDT pair; over six transactions about 1.06M DAO left the reward contract.
notes: The reset is the owner's ab19348c(DAO/USDT pair, true) on the reward contract (block 20664991), which made swaps through the pair 0xa760dcaa, created at 20663301, earn rewards; the contract and router were created and wired at 20638292-20638301 and are unverified. The 997,000 DAO funding at 20665055 only sizes the pool.

Anchor is the attacker's first reward-farming transaction: before it the reward contract never paid more than 3,000 DAO in one transaction (1,372 DAO over 2,383 earlier transactions). 0x439d77a2 only deployed the attack contract.

Loss is the attacker's realised USDT: the PancakeSwap DAO/USDT pair 0x38a4bbcc lost 1,174,994 USDT buying the reward DAO, of which 593,737 USDT went to the DAO Swap pair 0xa760dcaa as the round trips' cost; the two pairs are netted per transaction (rule 11). Without netting the loss would be 1.17M USD.
